scripts.dev: npm run compose && npm run prepare:sources && npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 preview
scripts.dev:no-open: npm run compose && npm run prepare:sources && npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 preview --no-open
scripts.check: npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 lint && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 validate && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 inspect
scripts.snapshot: npm run compose && npm run prepare:sources && npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 snapshot --frames 8
scripts.render:review: npm run compose && npm run prepare:sources && npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 render --fps 60 --quality high --video-frame-format png --output renders/preview/review.mp4
scripts.render:validation: npm run prepare:sources && npm run build && tsx tools/render-validation.ts
scripts.build:validation: npm run render:validation && npm run build && tsx tools/copy-validation-dist.ts
